name: Elspeth Tyrel
description: A planeswalker sent by Ajani who protects Giada, finds her sense of home and purpose in New Capenna, and receives a Halo-forged sword before wounding the Adversary.

description_citations.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
description_citations.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth writes a letter to Ajani, intending to sink it in a swamp as a prayer.
timeline.quote: I'm going to roll the parchment up, slide it into a ceramic vial, and sink it in a swamp.

citation.work: The Lost Confession
citation.text: "The Lost Confession". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Elspeth arrives on Theros in a bleak swamp and is cared for by snake-loving priests in a cave temple.
timeline.quote: When I arrived this time, I ended up in a bleak swamp near an entrance to a cave.

citation.work: The Lost Confession
citation.text: "The Lost Confession". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Melira provides immunity to the Phyrexian contagion.
timeline.quote: a young Mirran named Melira provided us with a natural immunity to the Phyrexian contagion

citation.work: The Lost Confession
citation.text: "The Lost Confession". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Koth infiltrate the praetors' cathedral-fortress.
timeline.quote: Koth and I managed to infiltrate their cathedral-fortress

citation.work: The Lost Confession
citation.text: "The Lost Confession". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Koth tells Elspeth she is leaving and that there is nothing to come back for.
timeline.quote: Seal this world off, and throw away the key.

citation.work: The Lost Confession
citation.text: "The Lost Confession". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Koth sinks Elspeth to her knees in stone and raises a wall between them.
timeline.quote: he just sunk me up to my knees in the stone and left me there

citation.work: The Lost Confession
citation.text: "The Lost Confession". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: An Obliterator breaks in and stabs Elspeth.
timeline.quote: two of its blades drove deep into my belly

citation.work: The Lost Confession
citation.text: "The Lost Confession". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Elspeth remembers Heliod and planeswalks to Theros.
timeline.quote: My blood rushed out of me as I left that nightmare world.

citation.work: The Lost Confession
citation.text: "The Lost Confession". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Elspeth resolves to stay in the temple until she understands the gods of Theros.
timeline.quote: I am resolved to stay here until I understand the nature of the world and its divine stewards.

citation.work: The Lost Confession
citation.text: "The Lost Confession". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Urabrask asks Vivien to find Elspeth, a planeswalker whom Norn fears.
timeline.quote: "Norn fears her. That is all I know."

citation.work: The Side of Freedom
citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Navy gives Vivien a lead that a woman named Elspeth is taking odd jobs in the Mezzio.
timeline.quote: "Oh, I got a lead on your Elspeth character, however."

citation.work: The Side of Freedom
citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien sees a woman fight off Maestro enforcers in the street and then watches her give her name to the vampire Anhelo.
timeline.quote: The woman ignored the gesture, continuing to walk before she said, "Elspeth."

citation.work: The Side of Freedom
citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Anhelo takes Elspeth to the Maestros' museum after she agrees to join the family.
timeline.quote: Anhelo had taken her right to the Maestros' museum after Elspeth had agreed to join the family

citation.work: The Side of Freedom
citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien intercepts Elspeth at the drop-off and catches her wrist; Elspeth admits she is learning the plane's history and is there on Ajani's behalf.
timeline.quote: "Ajani sent me."

citation.work: The Side of Freedom
citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth says New Capenna might be her home and that she wants to learn how its people beat a threat before.
timeline.quote: "It might be my home."

citation.work: The Side of Freedom
citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien declines to bring Elspeth to Urabrask yet, promising to share information when she has more, and leaves.
timeline.quote: "When I have something worthwhile."

citation.work: The Side of Freedom
citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien tells Urabrask she found Elspeth; Urabrask says she is the key and he will wait for her, her spark igniting his people and the Mirrans.
timeline.quote: "She is the key to our success."

citation.work: The Side of Freedom
citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth works the floor at the Crescendo, where Jinnie, Kitt and Giada approach her.
timeline.quote: Elspeth stood on the dance floor of the Vantoleone with a platter in hand.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Jinnie leads Giada onstage as Maestros begin to move through the crowd, and Elspeth senses something wrong.
timeline.quote: Something was wrong.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Giada touches an enormous empty bottle and it fills with Halo, which Jinnie presents as the Font, Halo made from nothing.
timeline.quote: we have made Halo from nothing .

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth realizes the cost: the Cabaretti's new era will cost the exhausted, trapped Giada her life.
timeline.quote: Their "new era" would come at the cost of Giada's life.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth fights through the chaos, defeats the Adversary's loyalists on stage and offers to take Giada away.
timeline.quote: "Would you like me to take you from here?"

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Giada flee through the wings and a back door, killing pursuers along the way.
timeline.quote: when her dagger sank into a man's gut with a gurgle, she knew she was right.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: In the alley, Vivien appears and kills the Adversary's goons with spectral wolves; Elspeth vouches for her to Giada.
timeline.quote: "Vivien's an ally; she can be trusted."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Jinnie, Jetmir and Cabaretti emerge and demand Giada be brought to them; Elspeth, sensing Giada's wishes, refuses.
timeline.quote: "Bring Giada to me."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien conjures a spectral dragon to block Jinnie, and the three flee into the night.
timeline.quote: the loops of a scaled dragon filled the alleyway.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth, Vivien and Giada flee across the Mezzio; Elspeth decides to retrieve a better weapon from the Maestros' museum.
timeline.quote: "I need a better weapon than a knife.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth finds the museum overrun, overhears that she is the Adversary's target number one, and takes a sword from the armory.
timeline.quote: "The Adversary has deemed her as target number one

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth, Vivien and Giada shelter in an abandoned warehouse, where Giada confesses her fear that her magic is not enough and Elspeth vows to keep her safe.
timeline.quote: "And I will personally ensure you are safe to take the time you need to do so, however long that is."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Jinnie and Cabaretti enforcers storm the warehouse office, disarming Vivien and holding a knife to Elspeth's throat.
timeline.quote: "You didn't really think you could escape us, did you?"

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Giada defends Elspeth, persuading Jinnie to let Jetmir decide; Jinnie shackles the two and takes them with Giada to see Jetmir.
timeline.quote: "Shackle them. We're taking them back to Jetmir."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Jinnie leads them to an Obscura hideout where Kamiz welcomes them, and a wounded Jetmir is being treated.
timeline.quote: "I see you were successful." Jetmir was settled in a lower bunk

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Giada makes Halo to heal Jetmir, but Riveteers and Maestro assassins burst in, and Elspeth and Vivien break free of their shackles.
timeline.quote: With a thought, her magic cracked open the locks

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth is mortally wounded in the brawl, seeing Erebos's cold approach, until Giada feeds her Halo that heals her.
timeline.quote: It smashed into her ribs as Elspeth had been straining to hoist her sword

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Giada's Halo mends Elspeth's bones; Elspeth sees Giada's glow.
timeline.quote: Wounds mended.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Kamiz leads the group through Obscura tunnels toward the Cloud Spire; Giada drops a tracking bracelet and Elspeth destroys it.
timeline.quote: Elspeth ground the bracelet under her boot.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Obscura enforcers ambush them in the park; Kamiz's trap is revealed and Elspeth, Vivien and Giada flee as Jinnie fights.
timeline.quote: This had all been a setup.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: In the cathedral Elspeth and Giada hear the angels' statues sing; Giada says it is her family and that she is home, and Elspeth realizes home is purpose.
timeline.quote: "My family. I'm home,"

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis arrives at the cathedral with enforcers; Vivien fires on him and Elspeth fights him but is thrown back.
timeline.quote: "Good of you to show yourself, Ob Nixilis."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Giada transforms into the radiant magic of Halo, blasting Ob Nixilis away and giving Elspeth strength.
timeline.quote: Giada was transformed into the radiant magic of Halo.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth's broadsword is transformed into a Halo-pommeled blade and she vows to defend New Capenna.
timeline.quote: The pommel wasn't a practical steel guard but an orb of Halo

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth wounds Ob Nixilis's neck with the new sword, and he planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: In a blink, he was gone, having planeswalked away.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Anhelo gives Elspeth and Vivien Xander's letter naming him successor and granting Elspeth access to the archives.
timeline.quote: The Maestros are now in your hands

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Vivien read the archives and learn the Phyrexians once attacked Capenna and the Demon Lords betrayed the angels to make Halo.
timeline.quote: The demons ultimately betrayed the angels

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien tells Elspeth of Urabrask's planned revolution on New Phyrexia, and they decide to take the Halo and the news to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: "Dominaria." Elspeth turned away from the city skyline of New Capenna.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

relations.note: Fought together on Mirrodin and pledged to die rather than be taken.
relations.quote: we promised each other we'd kill ourselves before they could take us apart limb from limb while we were still alive

citation.work: The Lost Confession
citation.text: "The Lost Confession". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: Elspeth writes to Ajani as a trusted friend.
relations.quote: When you look at me, you see all that I could be.

citation.work: The Lost Confession
citation.text: "The Lost Confession". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: Elspeth saw Heliod the day she got her sword.
relations.quote: I saw him the day I got my sword.

citation.work: The Lost Confession
citation.text: "The Lost Confession". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.quote: after Elspeth had agreed to join the family

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

citation.work: The Side of Freedom
citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

citation.work: The Side of Freedom
citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

relations.note: Took missions from Xander and was given his knife.
relations.quote: the knife Xander had given her

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

relations.note: Protects Giada from the Cabaretti and the Adversary.
relations.quote: "Would you like me to take you from here?"

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

relations.note: The Adversary has marked her as his primary target.
relations.quote: "The Adversary has deemed her as target number one

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

relations.note: Believes Elspeth is a traitor who took the Font.
relations.quote: "Liar. You wanted the Font for yourself."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

relations.note: Fight together and plan to go to Dominaria.
relations.quote: Elspeth was pleased it seemed like Vivien was ready to continue this journey with her.

citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

relations.quote: Steel met flesh, and she grazed off the side of his neck.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

relations.quote: she had resented her dear friend in those long-ago moments
